summary: Phase 3 additive testing on top of green 40/40 Phase 1+2 baseline. Added /app/backend/tests/test_phase3.py with 17 new tests covering Dynamic Categories (public GET by type=product/service/tender, admin CRUD, 403 for customer, audit log module=categories), Smart Signup (register with interests[]/business_type/primary_category persisted + reflected in /auth/me), White-Label Branding (public GET returns brand_name/logo/primary_color/tagline, admin PATCH 200, customer PATCH 403), Pricing Plans (public GET /api/plans returns 3 active with Starter=0, Business=4999, Enterprise), Commission Engine (admin GET/PUT with per-category overrides, customer PUT 403, order commission math: 2x10000 Solar @ 3% => 600.00 exact, unknown category @ default 5% => 50.00). Total: 57 pytest tests, 100% pass (17 new + 40 previous). Frontend E2E on https://db-design.preview.emergentagent.com: /pricing renders dynamic 3 plans with ₹4,999; /register shows 8 interest chips (data-testid interest-*); customer login lands on dashboard with [data-testid=personal-banner] visible (personal-interests chip not shown because seeded customer@2click.in has no interests array — expected per spec); super-admin dashboard Administration route exposes ALL 11 RBAC tabs including new rbac-tab-{categories,branding,pricing}. Categories tab shows product/service/tender groups with seeded names (Steel & TMT, Solar, Cement); White Label tab has brand-name/brand-color/brand-save with 'Branding saved' toast; Plans & Commission tab lists 3 plans + commission editor with comm-default input + comm-save button showing 'Commission saved' toast, Solar 3% and Steel & TMT 2.5% overrides render. No console errors, no 500s.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS allow_origins fallback '*' remains combined with allow_credentials=True (carry-over from earlier phases) — browsers will reject credentialed requests when origin echoes as *. Env sets explicit origins so this is not blocking in production, but the default is unsafe.
phase3.public_categories/plans respond without cache headers; consider short caching for these public endpoints since they change rarely.

server.py::create_order stores commission per-item using it['category'] but request payload from FE may not include category. When missing, default 5% is used, which is fine but should be documented in OrderIn schema.
phase3.seed_phase3 conditionally seeds only when collection is empty — safe & idempotent; but there is no version guard for the commission per_category defaults after future edits.

AdminRBAC.jsx already flagged in iter_3 as 263 lines mixing sub-components; Phase 3 added 3 more tabs (Categories/Branding/PricingCommission) — file will now be larger; consider splitting into per-tab components.
server.py imports phase3 inside create_order() on every call (lazy import). Fine, but could be moved to module level since phase3 is already imported at bottom of file.

Register user document stores interests/business_type/primary_category unconditionally; consider a lightweight validation (e.g., interests must be strings from known categories) to avoid arbitrary payloads.
seed_data_creation: phase3.seed_phase3 auto-seeds 10 product cats, 8 service cats, 6 tender cats, 3 plans (Starter/Business/Enterprise), and commission config (default 5%, Solar 3%, Steel & TMT 2.5%). Tests create TEST_-prefixed categories/users which remain (categories are soft-disabled, not hard-deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 endpoints: public GET /api/categories?type=..., /api/plans, /api/branding; admin under /api/admin/{categories,plans,branding,commission} guarded by rbac.rbac_admin. Order commission uses phase3.get_commission_config + commission_for(cfg, item.category). Frontend Admin RBAC now has 11 tabs; new: rbac-tab-categories, rbac-tab-branding, rbac-tab-pricing. Branding form testids: brand-name/brand-color/brand-logo/brand-save; commission form: comm-default/comm-save (per-category rows are input fields). Register interest chips: [data-testid^=interest-]. Dashboard personal banner: [data-testid=personal-banner], [data-testid=personal-interests] only renders when user has interests array populated (seeded demo customer does not).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Phase 3 shipped cleanly additive to iteration_3 baseline; all backend endpoints, guards, seeds, commission math, and UI wiring behave per spec.
